content.heading: Lumière
content.description: Experience invisible excellence at our flagship dining room in Mayfair.

content.heading: A sanctuary of light and culinary precision.
content.description: At Lumière, we believe the finest dining experiences are those where the service is felt but not seen. Every dish is a dialogue between tradition and innovation, meticulously crafted to showcase the purest essence of seasonal ingredients.
content.quote: The intersection of high-end hospitality and technical precision.
content.chefQuote: Culinary art is not found in complexity, but in the radical simplification of a flavor until its soul is revealed. At Lumière, we strip away the noise to let the ingredient speak.
content.chefBio: With three Michelin stars and a career spanning the finest kitchens of Lyon and Paris, Chef Vignon brings a technical rigor to Mayfair that is unmatched. Her vision for Lumière was to create a space where diners could lose track of time, anchored only by the rhythm of the season.

content.heading: Featured Dishes
content.description: A curated selection from our kitchen, chosen by Chef Vignon.

content.heading: The Lumière Gallery
content.description: Captured moments of invisible excellence

images.caption: Private dining vault featuring mahogany table and hand-blown amber chandelier.
Vintage premier grand cru classé poured into thin-stemmed crystal.
Deconstructed chocolate sphere with gold leaf on dark slate plate.
Precision garnish placement in our surgical kitchen environment.
Panoramic golden hour lighting across soaring ceilings and crisp linens.

content.heading: Special Offers
content.description: Seasonal promotions from the kitchen and cellar.

testimonials.quote: The most refined dining experience in Mayfair - every detail considered.
Chef Vignon’s tasting menu is a masterclass in restraint and flavor.
Impeccable service and a wine list to match. Our go-to for anniversaries.

content.heading: PulseFit Studios
content.description: Small-group strength & conditioning - real coaching, real community.

content.heading: Coaching first. Community always.
content.description: Small-group strength & conditioning led by certified coaches. Every session is programmed, scaled to you, and built to keep you coming back stronger.
content.quote: Strong is a skill - and skills are coached.
content.chefQuote: Nobody gets strong alone. We build the plan, you bring the effort, and the room carries you through the hard reps.
content.chefBio: A former collegiate athlete and certified strength coach with 12 years on the gym floor, Marcus founded PulseFit to make real coaching the default - not a premium extra.

content.heading: Featured Programs
content.description: The sessions our members keep coming back for.

content.heading: Inside PulseFit
content.description: Real members, real sessions, every day of the week.

content.heading: Member Offers
content.description: Start strong with our current deals.

testimonials.quote: Strongest I have ever been, and I actually look forward to training.
The coaches know everyone by name. It feels like a team, not a gym.
Finally a gym where nobody is intimidating - just encouraging.

content.heading: Nova Goods
content.description: Independent lifestyle & home goods - small-batch makers, thoughtfully curated.

content.heading: Made by small makers, chosen with care.
content.description: Every piece in the shop comes from an independent maker we know by name - ceramics, textiles and everyday objects built to last, not to trend.
content.quote: Buy fewer things. Choose them well.
content.chefQuote: I started Nova Goods to give brilliant small studios a shop window - and to make it easier to live with fewer, better things.
content.chefBio: After a decade buying for big-box retailers, Priya opened Nova Goods on Valencia Street in 2019. She still visits every maker before their work goes on the shelf.

content.heading: New Arrivals
content.description: Fresh from our makers this month.

content.heading: Styled at Home
content.description: How our customers live with their Nova Goods.

content.heading: Current Offers
content.description: Small savings on pieces made to last.

testimonials.quote: Every order feels like a gift - beautifully packed and thoughtfully made.
My go-to shop for presents. It has never once disappointed.
The dinner set is even nicer in person. We use it every single day.
